swe.1.title: Software Requirements Analysis
swe.1.description: Transform system requirements into a structured set of software requirements.

base_practices.title: Specify software requirements
details: ✅ Evidence found: Software Requirements Specification (SRS)
❌ Missing evidence: Alternative requirements document
✅ Check: Each requirement has a unique identifier (REQ-xxx) (31 unique REQ IDs parsed)
✅ Check: Each requirement contains SHALL statements (SRS with SHALL statements)
❌ Check: Requirements are traced to system requirements (no substantive traceability matrix)

base_practices.title: Structure software requirements
details: ❌ Missing evidence: Structured specs directory
❌ Check: Requirements are organized by functional area (no functional-area grouping found)
✅ Check: Requirements have defined attributes (priority, status)

base_practices.title: Evaluate impact of requirements
details: ✅ Evidence found: Impact analysis document
✅ Check: Changes to requirements trigger impact analysis (impact analysis with substantive content)
✅ Check: Impact analysis covers schedule, resources, and risks (impact analysis with substantive content)

swe.2.title: Software Architectural Design
swe.2.description:
Establish a software architectural design that identifies components,
their interfaces, and data flow.

base_practices.title: Develop software architecture
details: ✅ Evidence found: Software architecture document
❌ Missing evidence: Alternative architecture document
✅ Check: Architecture covers all software requirements (architecture doc with substantive content)
✅ Check: Architecture defines component boundaries and interfaces (architecture doc with substantive content)

base_practices.title: Define interfaces
details: ✅ Evidence found: Header files defining interfaces
✅ Check: All external interfaces are defined (2 substantive headers)
✅ Check: Interface specifications include data types and range (2 substantive headers)

base_practices.title: Verify architecture
details: ✅ Evidence found: Architecture review record
✅ Check: Architecture review is conducted and documented (architecture doc with substantive content)
❌ Check: Review findings are tracked to closure (no substantive review record found)

swe.3.title: Software Detailed Design and Unit Construction
swe.3.description: Develop a detailed design for each software component and construct units.

base_practices.title: Develop detailed design
details: ✅ Evidence found: Source code directory
✅ Check: Source code follows defined coding standards (coding-standard config with rules)
✅ Check: Each function has a clear, single responsibility (source code present)
✅ Check: Code complexity is managed (functions < 50 lines) (source code present)

base_practices.title: Define unit test cases
details: ✅ Evidence found: Unit test directory
❌ Check: Unit tests exist for each software unit (582 test files but no passing-run evidence)
❌ Check: Test cases cover normal, boundary, and error conditions (582 test files but no passing-run evidence)
❌ Check: Test cases are traceable to requirements (no substantive traceability matrix)

base_practices.title: Verify detailed design
details: ✅ Evidence found: Design review record
❌ Check: Design review is conducted per component (no substantive review record found)
❌ Check: Review covers correctness, consistency, and testability (582 test files but no passing-run evidence)

swe.4.title: Software Unit Verification
swe.4.description: Verify software units against the detailed design and requirements.

base_practices.title: Perform unit verification
details: ✅ Evidence found: Unit test results
❌ Missing evidence: CI test execution records
❌ Check: All unit tests pass (100% pass rate) (582 test files but no passing-run evidence)
❌ Check: Statement coverage ≥ 80%
❌ Check: Branch/condition coverage ≥ 70%

base_practices.title: Establish bidirectional traceability
details: ❌ Missing evidence: Traceability matrix
❌ Check: Each requirement is traced to unit tests (no substantive traceability matrix)
❌ Check: Traceability matrix is maintained and current (no substantive traceability matrix)

base_practices.title: Evaluate unit verification results
details: ❌ Missing evidence: Evidence collection
❌ Check: Failed tests are analyzed and documented (582 test files but no passing-run evidence)
❌ Check: Regression test strategy is defined (582 test files but no passing-run evidence)

swe.5.title: Software Integration and Integration Test
swe.5.description:
Integrate software units and verify the integrated software against
the architecture and requirements.

base_practices.title: Develop integration strategy
details: ✅ Evidence found: Integration strategy document
❌ Check: Integration sequence is defined and justified
✅ Check: Stubs/drivers are identified

base_practices.title: Integrate software units
details: ❌ Missing evidence: CI integration records
❌ Check: Integration builds succeed
❌ Check: Integration follows the defined strategy

base_practices.title: Perform integration tests
details: ❌ Missing evidence: Integration test directory
❌ Missing evidence: Integration test results
❌ Check: Integration tests cover component interfaces (582 test files but no passing-run evidence)
❌ Check: Integration tests verify data flow between components (582 test files but no passing-run evidence)
❌ Check: All integration tests pass (582 test files but no passing-run evidence)

swe.6.title: Software Qualification Test
swe.6.description:
Test the complete software against software requirements in the target
environment or a simulated environment.

base_practices.title: Develop qualification test strategy
details: ✅ Evidence found: Qualification test strategy
❌ Check: Qualification test scope covers all requirements (no SIL/HIL results — unit tests do not qualify as target/equivalent-environment execution)
❌ Check: Acceptance criteria are defined for each requirement (no substantive acceptance matrix)

base_practices.title: Perform qualification tests
details: ❌ Missing evidence: Qualification test results
❌ Missing evidence: SIL/HIL test results
❌ Check: All qualification tests pass (no SIL/HIL results — unit tests do not qualify as target/equivalent-environment execution)
❌ Check: Tests are executed in target or equivalent environment (no SIL/HIL results — unit tests do not qualify as target/equivalent-environment execution)
❌ Check: Resulting evidence is archived (no archived evidence found)

base_practices.title: Establish traceability
details: ❌ Missing evidence: Acceptance matrix
❌ Missing evidence: Requirement coverage report
❌ Check: Qualification tests are traceable to requirements (no substantive traceability matrix)
❌ Check: Coverage gaps are identified and documented
